about.title: About BDTS
about.subtitle: Insurance Expertise, Brussels Heart
about.story_body: BDTS (BDT Sironval) has served Brussels residents and businesses from our base in Laeken. We combine deep local knowledge with access to AG Insurance and the full Belgian insurance market.
about.what_body: We're independent insurance brokers. We work for you — not for one insurance company. We compare options and find the best fit, then advocate for you when you need to claim.
about.apropos_body: BDTS (BDT Sironval) is your independent insurance broker in Laeken, Brussels. Built on proximity, transparency, and local expertise, we support individuals and businesses at every stage of life. As a trusted AG Insurance partner, we compare the Belgian market to find you the best protection — and we stand by you when you need to claim.

responsabilite-civile.title: Liability Coverage
responsabilite-civile.subtitle: Mandatory third-party liability protection for your vehicle
description: Third-party liability (RC Auto) is mandatory in Belgium and covers damage you cause to other people, their vehicles and their property. Our coverage meets and exceeds Belgian legal minimums.
In the event of an accident where you are at fault, all bodily injury and property damage costs for third parties are covered without limit on personal injury claims.

benefits.title: Unlimited bodily injury
benefits.description: No cap on personal injury compensation paid to accident victims

benefits.title: Third-party vehicle damage
benefits.description: Full repair or replacement costs for vehicles damaged in accidents you cause

benefits.title: Passenger protection
benefits.description: Passengers in your vehicle are covered as third parties if injured

benefits.title: European coverage
benefits.description: Liability coverage valid across all EU member states with green card

dommages-materiels.title: Material Damage
dommages-materiels.subtitle: Protection against damage to your own vehicle
description: Material damage coverage (Omnium or Mini-Omnium) protects your own vehicle against collision damage, regardless of fault. Both partial and full omnium options are available to match your needs and budget.
Agreed vehicle value settlement ensures a fair payout without depreciation disputes, and a replacement vehicle is provided while yours is being repaired.

benefits.title: Collision damage
benefits.description: Repair costs for your vehicle after any collision, whether at fault or not

benefits.title: Weather and natural events
benefits.description: Hail, storm, flood and other weather-related damage to your vehicle

benefits.title: Replacement vehicle
benefits.description: Rental vehicle provided while your car is undergoing repairs

benefits.title: Agreed value settlement
benefits.description: Payout based on agreed vehicle value, not depreciated market estimates

vol-et-incendie.title: Theft and Fire
vol-et-incendie.subtitle: Coverage against vehicle theft, attempted theft and fire
description: Vehicle theft is a significant risk in Brussels and the wider Belgian urban environment. Our theft and fire coverage ensures you are fully compensated if your vehicle is stolen or damaged by fire.
Attempted theft damage — broken windows, forced locks, damaged ignition — is covered even when the vehicle itself is not taken.

benefits.title: Full theft replacement
benefits.description: Market value replacement if your vehicle is not recovered within 30 days

benefits.title: Fire damage coverage
benefits.description: Complete repair or replacement if your vehicle is damaged or destroyed by fire

benefits.title: Attempted theft damage
benefits.description: Broken windows, locks and ignition damage from theft attempts are covered

benefits.title: Tracking service
benefits.description: GPS tracking assistance and coordination with police for stolen vehicles

protection-juridique-auto.title: Legal Coverage
protection-juridique-auto.subtitle: Legal protection and assistance for vehicle-related disputes
description: Vehicle-related legal disputes — from contested accident liability to garage repair disputes and traffic offence defence — are covered by our auto legal protection.
Expert legal advisors handle your case from initial consultation through to court representation, with all associated costs covered by your policy.

benefits.title: Accident liability disputes
benefits.description: Legal representation when fault in an accident is contested by another party

benefits.title: Traffic offence defence

benefits.title: Garage and repair disputes

assistance-depannage.subtitle: 24/7 roadside assistance and towing service
description: Breakdown assistance gives you peace of mind knowing that wherever you break down in Belgium or Europe, help is just one phone call away. Our 24/7 service dispatches a qualified mechanic or tow truck.
From flat tyres and dead batteries to complex mechanical failures, we cover roadside repair or towing to the nearest approved garage, plus onward travel for you and your passengers.

services-soutien-famille.title: Family Support Services
services-soutien-famille.subtitle: Practical support when families face difficult situations
description: Life events like serious illness, disability or the loss of a breadwinner can create practical challenges beyond financial ones. Our family support services provide hands-on assistance when you need it most.
From childcare coordination and home help to administrative support and legal advice, we help families navigate difficult periods with expert guidance.

benefits.title: Emergency childcare
benefits.description: Childcare coordination if a parent is hospitalised or incapacitated

benefits.title: Home help services
benefits.description: Domestic assistance and home maintenance during recovery periods

benefits.title: Administrative support
benefits.description: Help navigating government benefits, insurance claims and paperwork

benefits.title: Legal guidance
benefits.description: Access to legal advisors for family law, inheritance and dispute matters

rente-familiale-deces.title: Family Income on Death
rente-familiale-deces.subtitle: Guaranteed income for spouse and children if the breadwinner passes away
description: The death of a breadwinner can leave a family in acute financial difficulty. Our family income death benefit provides a guaranteed monthly income to the surviving spouse and children for an agreed period.
Capital lump-sum options are also available alongside or instead of income, ensuring flexibility to pay off a mortgage or cover immediate expenses.

benefits.title: Monthly guaranteed income
benefits.description: Regular income paid to surviving spouse for up to 20 years after death

benefits.title: Children's education fund
benefits.description: Additional capital to fund children's education through to university

benefits.title: Mortgage protection option
benefits.description: Lump sum option sized to repay the outstanding home loan

benefits.title: Fast benefit payment
benefits.description: First payment within 30 days of death certificate submission

accidents-24h.title: 24/7 Accident Benefits
accidents-24h.subtitle: Complete coverage for accidents at any time of day or night
description: Our 24/7 accident coverage protects you against the financial consequences of any personal accident, whether it occurs at work, at home, during sport or leisure activities.
Coverage is worldwide and continuous — there is no restriction on the time or place of the accident, giving you complete peace of mind in all daily situations.

benefits.title: Round-the-clock protection
benefits.description: Coverage active 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year

benefits.title: Worldwide coverage
benefits.description: Accidents covered anywhere in the world, not just in Belgium

benefits.title: Sports and leisure
benefits.description: Accidents during sporting activities and hobbies are covered

benefits.title: Immediate benefit payment
benefits.description: Benefits paid within 30 days of medical certification of the accident

invalidite-permanente.title: Permanent Disability Coverage
invalidite-permanente.subtitle: Financial protection if you become permanently disabled
description: Permanent disability from an accident can fundamentally change your life and earning capacity. Our disability benefit provides a capital lump sum based on the degree of disability assessed by an independent medical expert.
Partial disability is covered on a pro-rata basis, ensuring that even partial loss of function results in meaningful financial support.

benefits.title: Pro-rata partial disability
benefits.description: Compensation proportional to degree of disability from 5% upward

benefits.title: Independent medical assessment
benefits.description: Disability degree assessed by a neutral, independent medical expert

benefits.title: Capital lump sum
benefits.description: One-time payment allowing you to adapt your home or lifestyle as needed

benefits.title: Rehabilitation support
benefits.description: Reimbursement of rehabilitation costs to maximise recovery potential

frais-medicaux-hospitaliers.title: Medical and Hospital Expenses
frais-medicaux-hospitaliers.subtitle: Reimbursement of medical fees resulting from accidents
description: Accidents generate medical expenses that are not always fully covered by Belgian public health insurance. Our accident medical coverage tops up your statutory reimbursements to ensure no out-of-pocket costs.
Emergency treatment, hospitalisation, physiotherapy, dental repair and prosthetics following accidents are all reimbursed up to the insured limit.

benefits.title: Emergency treatment
benefits.description: Emergency room and urgent care costs reimbursed in full

benefits.title: Physiotherapy
benefits.description: Full course of physiotherapy following accident injury covered

benefits.title: Dental repair
benefits.description: Dental injuries from accidents repaired and reimbursed

benefits.title: Prosthetics and aids
benefits.description: Prosthetic limbs, wheelchairs and mobility aids covered after accident

incapacite-temporaire.title: Temporary Disability Income
incapacite-temporaire.subtitle: Income replacement during temporary disability from accidents
description: When an accident prevents you from working temporarily, our daily benefit pays a fixed daily allowance for every day you are medically certified as unable to work, supplementing your employer's sick pay or statutory benefits.
The benefit begins from the first day of disability (or after a short waiting period depending on your chosen option) and continues until you are certified fit to return to work.

benefits.title: Daily cash benefit
benefits.description: Fixed daily allowance paid for each day of certified work incapacity

benefits.title: From day one option
benefits.description: Optional coverage from the very first day of disability with no waiting period

benefits.title: Self-employed protection
benefits.description: Especially valuable for self-employed whose income stops immediately with disability

benefits.title: Simple certification
benefits.description: Benefit triggered by GP medical certificate, no complex claims process

capital-deces.title: Death Capital
capital-deces.subtitle: Lump sum paid to beneficiaries upon the insured's death
description: A death capital policy provides a one-time lump sum payment to your designated beneficiaries upon your death. The capital can be used to pay off a mortgage, cover funeral costs or provide financial stability.
You choose the capital amount and the beneficiaries. Coverage is available with or without a medical exam depending on the sum insured, and premiums are fixed for the duration of the policy.

benefits.title: Flexible capital amounts
benefits.description: Choose the capital from €25,000 to €1,000,000 based on your family's needs

benefits.title: Named beneficiaries
benefits.description: You designate exactly who receives the capital and in what proportions

benefits.title: 30-day payment guarantee
benefits.description: Capital paid to beneficiaries within 30 days of death certificate receipt

benefits.title: Mortgage protection use
benefits.description: Capital sized to repay your outstanding mortgage for complete home security

rente-conjoint.title: Spouse Survivor Income
rente-conjoint.subtitle: Monthly income guaranteed to the surviving spouse
description: A survivor income policy guarantees your spouse a monthly or annual income for a defined period or for life following your death. This provides sustainable financial security beyond a one-time capital payment.
Income can be indexed to inflation and can include an optional survivor guarantee ensuring a minimum total payout regardless of when the surviving spouse dies.

benefits.title: Monthly income for life option
benefits.description: Income paid to surviving spouse for their entire remaining lifetime

benefits.title: Inflation indexing
benefits.description: Income indexed annually to maintain purchasing power over time

benefits.title: Minimum payout guarantee
benefits.description: Guaranteed minimum total payout regardless of beneficiary's lifespan

benefits.title: Tax-efficient structure
benefits.description: Survivor income benefits benefit from favourable Belgian tax treatment

protection-enfants-mineurs.title: Minor Children Coverage
protection-enfants-mineurs.subtitle: Capital or income to support children's education after a parent's death
description: The death of a parent creates not only emotional but also financial challenges for minor children. Our children's death benefit provides dedicated capital or monthly income to fund education and support until children reach adulthood.
Benefits can be structured to increase as children reach key milestones — secondary school, higher education — ensuring adequate funding at each stage.

benefits.title: Education capital
benefits.description: Dedicated capital to fund primary, secondary and higher education

benefits.title: Milestone-based payments
benefits.description: Structured payments timed to coincide with key educational transitions

benefits.title: Per-child benefit
benefits.description: Separate capital or income allocated to each minor child in the family

benefits.title: Until age of majority
benefits.description: Benefits paid until each child reaches 18 or 25 if still in education

paiement-accelere.title: Fast Payout to Beneficiaries
paiement-accelere.subtitle: Accelerated benefit payment process for designated beneficiaries
description: Our priority claims process ensures that death benefits reach your beneficiaries as quickly as possible — typically within 30 days of receiving a valid death certificate and completed claim form.
A dedicated claims advisor is assigned to your family from the moment of notification to guide them through the process and minimise paperwork during a difficult time.

benefits.title: 30-day payment target
benefits.description: Capital or first income payment within 30 days of valid claim submission

benefits.title: Dedicated claims advisor
benefits.description: Personal claims handler assigned to guide your family through the process

benefits.title: Simplified paperwork
benefits.description: Minimal documentation requirements — death certificate and ID are sufficient

benefits.title: 24/7 bereavement line
benefits.description: Immediate support line available to notify and begin the claims process

assistance-medicale-etranger.title: Medical Assistance Abroad
assistance-medicale-etranger.subtitle: 24/7 medical service and evacuation during your travels
description: Medical emergencies abroad can be frightening and expensive. Our medical assistance service is available 24/7 in multiple languages to coordinate your care, liaise with local hospitals and arrange payment guarantees.
From a simple GP visit to emergency surgery, we handle the logistics so you can focus on recovery. All medical costs are covered directly — no upfront payment required.

benefits.title: 24/7 multilingual helpline
benefits.description: Medical assistance line available in French, Dutch, English and more

benefits.title: Hospital cost guarantee
benefits.description: Direct payment guarantee to foreign hospitals — no upfront payment needed

benefits.title: Worldwide coverage
benefits.description: Medical assistance available in every country including outside Europe

benefits.title: Medical monitoring
benefits.description: Our team monitors your condition throughout hospitalisation abroad

evacuation-medicale.title: Medical Evacuation
evacuation-medicale.subtitle: Repatriation if seriously hospitalised abroad
description: If you are seriously ill or injured abroad and require specialist treatment unavailable locally, or if you wish to be treated in Belgium, our medical evacuation service organises medically supervised repatriation.
All costs — air ambulance, medical escort, ground transport and family member travel — are covered without limit.

benefits.title: Air ambulance service
benefits.description: Medically equipped air transport back to Belgium when medically necessary

benefits.title: Family member travel
benefits.description: One accompanying family member's travel costs covered during repatriation

benefits.title: Repatriation of remains
benefits.description: Dignified repatriation of remains to Belgium covered in the event of death

benefits.title: Medical escort
benefits.description: Qualified medical professional accompanies you during evacuation flight

annulation-retard-vol.title: Flight Cancellation and Delay
annulation-retard-vol.subtitle: Reimbursement if your trip is cancelled or flight significantly delayed
description: Travel disruption can result in significant financial loss — non-refundable hotel bookings, tour packages and event tickets. Our cancellation and delay coverage reimburses these costs when travel is disrupted for covered reasons.
Covered reasons include illness, death in the family, redundancy, jury service, natural disasters and airline insolvency, among others.

benefits.title: Trip cancellation
benefits.description: Non-refundable prepaid costs reimbursed if trip cancelled for covered reasons

benefits.title: Delay compensation
benefits.description: Daily allowance for delays over 4 hours including meals and accommodation

benefits.title: Missed connection
benefits.description: Additional costs covered when a delay causes you to miss a connecting flight

benefits.title: Airline insolvency
benefits.description: Reimbursement if your airline or tour operator becomes insolvent

bagages-effets-personnels.title: Baggage and Personal Effects
bagages-effets-personnels.subtitle: Protection for lost, stolen or damaged luggage during travel
description: Lost luggage and stolen belongings can disrupt your entire trip. Our baggage coverage provides reimbursement for lost, stolen or damaged luggage and personal effects, plus emergency purchases if your bags are delayed.
Valuables, electronics and sports equipment carried in your luggage can be specifically declared for higher coverage limits.

benefits.title: Lost or stolen luggage
benefits.description: Full reimbursement of luggage contents at replacement value

benefits.title: Delayed luggage allowance
benefits.description: Emergency purchase allowance if luggage is delayed by more than 12 hours

benefits.title: Electronics declaration
benefits.description: Higher limits available for declared electronics and valuables

benefits.title: Airline liability top-up
benefits.description: Covers the gap between airline liability limits and actual item value

responsabilite-civile-voyage.title: Liability Insurance
responsabilite-civile-voyage.subtitle: Liability coverage for damage caused to third parties during travel
description: Accidents during travel can result in claims against you — a collision on a ski slope, accidental damage to a hotel room or injury to another tourist. Our travel liability coverage protects you against these claims.
Coverage extends to all family members travelling together and includes legal defence costs if your liability is contested.

benefits.title: Personal injury to third parties
benefits.description: Compensation for injury accidentally caused to others during your trip

benefits.title: Property damage
benefits.description: Accidental damage to hotel rooms, rental equipment and third-party property

benefits.title: Whole family covered
benefits.description: All family members on the same trip covered under the single policy

benefits.title: Legal defence costs
benefits.description: Lawyer fees and court costs covered if liability is legally contested

conseil-juridique-24h.title: 24/7 Legal Advice
conseil-juridique-24h.subtitle: Phone consultation with legal experts available day and night
description: Legal questions don't respect office hours. Our 24/7 legal advice hotline gives you immediate telephone access to qualified Belgian lawyers who can advise on your situation at any time.
From consumer disputes and neighbour conflicts to employment questions and family law, our advisors cover the full range of everyday legal matters.

benefits.title: Round-the-clock availability
benefits.description: Legal advisors available by phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

benefits.title: All areas of law
benefits.description: Advice on civil, consumer, employment, family and administrative law

benefits.title: French, Dutch and English
benefits.description: Legal advice available in all three Belgian national languages plus English

benefits.title: Written follow-up
benefits.description: Written summary of advice provided for your records after each consultation

defense-en-justice.title: Court Defense
defense-en-justice.subtitle: Legal representation and defense in your court proceedings
description: When a dispute escalates to legal proceedings, our legal protection coverage funds your full legal defense. You choose your own lawyer — we pay their fees and all associated court costs.
Coverage applies to both defending against claims made against you and pursuing claims on your behalf against a third party.

benefits.title: Free choice of lawyer
benefits.description: You choose your own lawyer — we cover their fees without restriction

benefits.title: All court levels
benefits.description: Proceedings at first instance, appeal and cassation levels all covered

benefits.title: Prosecution and defence
benefits.description: Coverage both for bringing claims against others and defending against claims

benefits.title: No coverage cap on legal fees
benefits.description: Legal fees covered in full without a ceiling for covered disputes

frais-juridiques.title: Legal Costs Covered
frais-juridiques.subtitle: Complete coverage of court fees and lawyer fees
description: Legal proceedings generate numerous costs beyond lawyer fees — court registry fees, expert witness costs, bailiff fees, translation costs and more. Our policy covers all of these without a separate budget for each.
Even if you lose your case, all costs incurred up to the policy limit are covered, protecting you from a double financial blow.

benefits.title: Court registry fees
benefits.description: All official court fees and registry costs covered in full

benefits.title: Expert witness costs
benefits.description: Court-appointed and privately instructed expert fees covered

benefits.title: Bailiff fees
benefits.description: Costs of bailiff services for enforcement of court orders covered

benefits.title: Costs even on loss
benefits.description: Legal costs covered even if the court rules against you

recours-juridique-assiste.title: Assisted Legal Recourse
recours-juridique-assiste.subtitle: Full support in all your legal claims and court actions
description: Pursuing a legal claim can be complex and time-consuming. Our assisted recourse service provides a dedicated case manager who coordinates your legal team, monitors deadlines and keeps you informed throughout.
From initial advice through to final judgment, you have a single point of contact who understands your situation and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

benefits.title: Dedicated case manager
benefits.description: Personal case coordinator who guides you throughout your legal proceedings

benefits.title: Deadline monitoring
benefits.description: All legal deadlines tracked and alerts sent to ensure nothing is missed

benefits.title: Regular progress updates
benefits.description: Status updates at every key stage of your case without needing to ask

benefits.title: Mediation first
benefits.description: Mediation and amicable resolution explored first to save time and cost
